content.content:
Apply to the dependent's recorded text, read against the four prerequisites as each is recorded at check time. The dependent passes only if all three criteria hold; fail on any missing element or contradiction, naming the element and, where it applies, the prerequisite.

1. License. No element of the dependent contradicts a prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element and the prerequisite clause it contradicts.

2. Independent weight. Every prerequisite in depends_on carries at least one element of the dependent, and no element leans on a prerequisite for a property that prerequisite does not state. Fail if a listed prerequisite carries no element, or if an element takes from a prerequisite a grant that prerequisite does not make — naming the element and the prerequisite.

3. Grounded addition. Where the dependent states something no prerequisite states, the text presents it as the dependent's own; it never presents a rule as granted by a prerequisite that does not state it, and where it takes a property a prerequisite fixes it takes that property rather than narrowing it or deciding it again. Fail on an element attributed to a prerequisite that does not record it, or on an element that narrows or re-decides a property a prerequisite already fixes — naming the element and the prerequisite.
content.rationale: Every edge here has the dependent on its prose side: the dependent is text and so are two of its prerequisites, a third is recorded as a requirement sentence, and the fourth records its content in Rust source. So the edges span three cells — natural-to-natural is the gate form itself, and structured-to-natural and code-to-natural both fall in the default cell, the same gate form plus a flag to extend the matrix — and in none of them may the check demand behavior, because the strictness rule forbids probing a prose child. The source-recorded prerequisite is therefore read as evidence of what the store holds and lends, never run as a test of the dependent; a reviewer applies the criteria to the dependent's recorded text against the four prerequisites read at check time, and nothing runs. The four edges are bundled in one evaluation because one read-through settles them together: each prerequisite fixes a different property the dependent must use and must not re-decide — the store's one held and lent root, the trunk fixed by place and resolved from the invocation workspace with no fallback, the trunk's ownership of the marker stack with the draft's exclusion, and the requirement that the stack be read and written only from the trunk — so criterion 2 keeps each edge load-bearing instead of letting one prerequisite stand in for another, and criterion 3 keeps the check from ratifying a new rule as though a prerequisite had granted it.
